subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What does “las afueras” mean?
questions.explain: “Las afueras” means “the outskirts” of a town, where many people live.

questions.q: How do you say “My town is quite lively”?
questions.explain: “Animada” = lively and a permanent characteristic uses “ser”: “Mi ciudad es bastante animada”.

questions.q: Which means “My bedroom is on the first floor”?
options: Mi dormitorio es en el primer piso
Mi cocina está en el primer piso
Mi dormitorio está en la planta baja
Mi dormitorio está en el primer piso
questions.explain: “El primer piso” = the first floor and location uses “estar”.

questions.q: What does “veranear” mean?
questions.explain: “Veranear” means “to spend the summer holidays” (from “verano”, summer).

questions.q: What does 'el medio ambiente' mean?
questions.explain: 'El medio ambiente' is the fixed term for 'the environment' (nature).

questions.q: How do you say “My house has four bedrooms”?
questions.explain: “El dormitorio” = bedroom, so “cuatro dormitorios” = four bedrooms.

questions.q: How do you say “I'd like a return ticket to Seville”?
options: Querías un billete de ida y vuelta a Sevilla
Quería una entrada de ida y vuelta a Sevilla
Quería un billete de ida y vuelta a Sevilla
Quería un billete de ida a Sevilla
questions.explain: “Ida y vuelta” = return and “un billete” = a ticket (“una entrada” is for events).

questions.q: What does “el jardín” mean?
questions.explain: “El jardín” means “the garden”.

questions.q: What does “la cocina” mean?
questions.explain: “La cocina” means “the kitchen” (it can also mean “the cooker”).

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to book a double room'?
options: Me gusta reservar una habitación doble
Me gustaría recordar una habitación doble
Me gustaría reservar una habitación individual
Me gustaría reservar una habitación doble
questions.explain: 'Reservar' = 'to book' and 'doble' = 'double'; 'recordar' (to remember) is a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: How do you say 'I live in a quiet neighbourhood'?
questions.explain: 'El barrio' is masculine, so 'tranquilo' agrees; 'vivo' is the correct first-person form.

questions.q: What does “el barrio” mean?
questions.explain: “El barrio” means “the neighbourhood/district”.

questions.q: What does “hacer cola” mean?
questions.explain: “Hacer cola” is an idiom meaning “to queue / stand in line”.

questions.q: What does “está a las afueras, lejos del centro” describe about a place?
options: It is right in the town centre
It is on the outskirts, far from the centre
questions.explain: “Lejos del centro” means “far from the centre”, so the place is on the outskirts.

questions.q: What does “la playa” mean?
questions.explain: “La playa” means “the beach”.

questions.q: What does 'el billete de ida y vuelta' mean?
questions.explain: 'Ida y vuelta' means 'there and back', so 'el billete de ida y vuelta' = 'a return ticket'.

questions.q: How do you say “There isn't much to do in my village”?
options: No hay nada de hacer en mi ciudad
No hay mucho que hago en mi pueblo
No hay mucho que hacer en mi pueblo
Hay mucho que hacer en mi pueblo
questions.explain: “No hay mucho que hacer” = “there isn't much to do” and “mi pueblo” = “my village”.

questions.q: How do you say “There are lots of shops near my house”?
options: Hay muchas tiendas lejos de mi casa
Hay muchas tiendas cerca de mi casa
Hay pocas tiendas cerca de mi casa
Hay muchas tienda cerca de mi casa
questions.explain: “Muchas tiendas” = lots of shops and “cerca de mi casa” = near my house.

questions.q: What does 'el alojamiento' mean?
questions.explain: 'El alojamiento' means 'accommodation' (where you stay); 'alojarse' = 'to stay/lodge'.

questions.q: What does “la aduana” mean?
questions.explain: “La aduana” means “customs”, where bags may be checked when crossing a border.

questions.q: Which means “In my town there is a leisure centre and a library”?
options: En mi ciudad hay una librería y una biblioteca
En mi ciudad hay un polideportivo y una biblioteca
En mi ciudad había un polideportivo y una biblioteca
En mi ciudad hay un polideportivo y una librería
questions.explain: “El polideportivo” = sports/leisure centre and “la biblioteca” = library (“librería” is a bookshop, a false friend).

questions.q: How do you say “I have lived here for ten years”?
options: Vivía aquí desde hace diez años
Voy a vivir aquí diez años
Vivo aquí desde hace diez años
questions.explain: For an action continuing into the present, Spanish uses the present + “desde hace”: “Vivo aquí desde hace diez años”.
